tests.name: power_on_selftest
tests.description: Boot the unit and enumerate devices on I2C, UART and CAN.

tests.name: battery_rest_check
tests.description: Read pack and per-cell voltages at rest.

tests.name: esc_telemetry
tests.description: Read ESC telemetry: sync errors, packet loss, back-EMF detection.

tests.description: Compare compass heading to the fixture reference with motors off.

tests.description: Measure per-bus continuity resistance and CAN termination.

tests.name: camera_selftest
tests.description: Run camera built-in self test and measure frame rate and CSI errors.

tests.name: imu_static
tests.description: Log 1000 IMU samples on the static fixture: gyro bias, accel noise, dropouts.

tests.name: motor_spin_test
tests.description: Spin all motors at 50 percent throttle: current, RPM, RPM jitter, temp.

tests.name: compass_motor_interference
tests.description: Sweep throttle 0-75 percent and log compass heading deviation.

tests.name: battery_load_test
tests.description: Apply a 20 A load and measure sag, cell imbalance, internal resistance.

steps.thought: I will run power_on_selftest to check the basic health and device enumeration of all subsystems.
steps.observation: Power-on selftest failed because CAN enumerated only 3 of 4 nodes instead of all 4, indicating a potential issue with the CAN bus or one of the nodes.

hypotheses.rationale: Missing CAN terminator or incomplete bus node response can cause incomplete CAN node enumeration.
A damaged CAN stub wire could prevent one of the four nodes from communicating properly during enumeration.

steps.thought: I will run the harness continuity test to check CAN bus termination and stub wire resistance.
steps.observation: Harness continuity test reveals a CAN termination resistance of 120.3 ohms, which is well outside the expected 54-66 ohm window for a properly terminated dual-resistor CAN bus, confirming a missing CAN bus terminator.

hypotheses.rationale: Measured CAN termination resistance of 120.3 ohms indicates only one terminator is present instead of both (which would measure ~60 ohms), explaining the missing node during enumeration.
Less likely since the CAN bus resistance continuity is ok and the termination resistance value specifically matches a single remaining 120-ohm resistor.

steps.thought: The CAN termination resistance of 120.3 ohms and power-on selftest failure enumerating 3 of 4 nodes conclusively point to a missing CAN bus terminator. I will now propose installing the missing CAN terminator.
